claims: Brad Underwood is the head coach of the University of Illinois men's basketball team.
The University of Illinois men's basketball team is the Fighting Illini.
Brad Underwood has held the position of head coach since 2017.
2025-26 is Brad Underwood's 9th season as head coach.
As of March 2026, Brad Underwood has a 190-109 record with the Fighting Illini.
As of March 2026, Brad Underwood has a .635 winning percentage with the Fighting Illini.
Brad Underwood led the Fighting Illini to a Big Ten Tournament championship in 2021.
Brad Underwood led the Fighting Illini to a Big Ten regular season championship in 2024.
Brad Underwood led the Fighting Illini to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Brad Underwood's contract has recently been extended.
Orlando Antigua is the associate head coach for the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Geoff Alexander is an assistant coach for the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Tyler Underwood is an assistant coach for the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Camryn Crocker is an assistant coach for the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Shauna Green was hired in 2022 as the head coach of the Illinois women's basketball team.
The 2025-26 University of Illinois men's basketball team achieved a No. 3 seed in the NCAA Tournament.
